# ☀️ Morning Briefing — Sunday, May 24, 2026

## 🌅 Morning Routine Checklist
- [ ] Wake up
- [ ] Drink water
- [ ] Meditate / breathe (10 min)
- [ ] Morning stretch or movement
- [ ] Breakfast
- [ ] Review this briefing
- [ ] Set 3 intentions for the day

## ✅ Today's Focus
- [ ] **Private piano session (20 min, no goal):** Sunday is protected time. Sit at the keys with nothing to prove — this is the root system the audit identified. No recording, no content.
- [ ] **Draft the €97 Independent Artist Toolkit outline:** List the 10 most-asked questions you get from emerging artists. This is the skeleton of your first paid knowledge product.
- [ ] **Flutter repositioning notes:** Write 3 bullet points on how Cyberian's neurofeedback + music wellness vision changes the $40k pitch. Don't send anything yet — just clarify the reframe.

## 💭 Pattern to Watch
Today notice the pull to turn private making into content. The audit was clear: the habit of converting every creative act into something shareable has hollowed out the practice itself. If you sit at the piano, the temptation will arise to film it, post it, narrate it. Watch for that impulse without acting on it. Some things are allowed to remain yours alone. The inner life needs protection to regenerate.
